voice:
ifreq = cpsmidinn(p4)
iamp = ampdbfs(p5)


// SLIDER VALUES

; LFO Rate: 0.3 Hz to 20 Hz (Exponential/Semi-Log resolution)

; LFO Delay Time: 0 to 2 seconds (Exponential response)
; 0.001 is used as a floor to avoid log(0) issues in scaling
iLFODelayTime = i(<lfo_delay_time>)
iLFODelay = (iLFODelayTime == 0 ? 0 : 0.001 * pow(2000, iLFODelayTime / 10)) 

; LFO Pitch Modulation: 0 to 300 cents
kPitchCents = (<dco_lfo> / 10) * 300

; Panel A: 50k linear pots with 47k wiper loads (VR20/21, R176/177).
; Buffer/DAC control-voltage approximation; zero is exact off.
; bias offsets and diode source switching need hardware measurement.
kSubPosition = limit(<dco_sub> / 10, 0, 1)
kNoisePosition = limit(<dco_noise> / 10, 0, 1)
kSubLevel = kSubPosition / (1 + (50/47)*kSubPosition*(1-kSubPosition))
kNoiseLevel = kNoisePosition / (1 + (50/47)*kNoisePosition*(1-kNoisePosition))


; VCF Resonance: 0 to Self-Oscillation (Linear)
kResonance = <vcf_res> / 10

; VCF ENV: provisional 12-oct maximum; svc. 8-9 targets ~30kHz, not slider law.
kEnvModOct = (<vcf_env> / 10) * 12

; VCF LFO Modulation: 0 to +/-3 octaves (svc. manual 8-7: 6Vp-p)
kLfoModOct = (<vcf_lfo> / 10) * 3.0




; Envelope Attack: 1 ms to 3 seconds (cubic in slider position)
iEnvA = 0.001 + (3.0 - 0.001) * pow(i(<env_attack>) / 10, 3)

; Envelope Decay: 2 ms to 12 seconds (cubic in slider position)
iEnvD = 0.002 + (12.0 - 0.002) * pow(i(<env_decay>) / 10, 3)

; Envelope Sustain: 0 to 100% (Linear)
iEnvS = i(<env_sustain>) / 10

; Envelope Release: 2 ms to 12 seconds (cubic in slider position)
iEnvR = 0.002 + (12.0 - 0.002) * pow(i(<env_release>) / 10, 3)


tigoto skipInit

// MAIN SIGNAL PROCESSING
kDelayRamp = (iLFODelay == 0 ? 1 : linseg(0, iLFODelay, 1, 0.01, 1))
Sjno60Lfo sprintf "jno60_lfo_%d", <INSTR_ID>
kLfoVal chnget Sjno60Lfo
kTrigGate = (<lfo_trigger_mode> < 0.5 ? 1 : <lfo_trig>)
klfo = kLfoVal * kDelayRamp * kTrigGate
aEnv = transegr:a(0, iEnvA, -4.2, 1, iEnvD, -4.2, iEnvS, iEnvR, -4.2, 0)

asig = 0

kFreq = ifreq * cent(klfo * kPitchCents)

if(<dco_saw_enabled> == 1) then
  asig = vco2(1, kFreq)
endif

if(<dco_pulse_enabled> == 1) then
  ; VR19 50kB, R175 47k: loaded slider voltage, not linear position.
  kPwmPosition = limit(<dco_pwm> / 10, 0, 1)
  kPwmDepth = 0.45 * kPwmPosition / (1 + (50/47)*kPwmPosition*(1-kPwmPosition))

  ; Panel A IC18: LFO R170=82k, R172=120k, R173=33k;
  ; MAN R174=39k, R171=15k; both loaded by R115=82k + R117=470.
  ; Raw TP17 LFO is +/-10V, independent of vibrato delay/trigger.
  ; Ratios below use the loaded MAN reference and nominal +15V rail.
  if(<dco_pwm_source> == 0) then
    kPwmSource = 0.539110334 + 0.525961301 * kLfoVal
  elseif(<dco_pwm_source> == 1) then
    kPwmSource = 1
  else
    ; ENV normalized peak is provisional; measure TP6 to calibrate.
    kPwmSource = k(aEnv)
  endif
  ; Service 9-1/9-2: MAN endpoints are 50% and 95% high duty.
  kPwmWidth = limit(0.5 + kPwmDepth * kPwmSource, 0, 1)
  ; Falling hardware saw drives comparator (-); its high duty is at cycle end.
  ; vco2's pulse has high duty at cycle start: complement and invert it
  ; to match the hardware comparator polarity/edge relative to the saw.
  ; Reject duty-dependent mean (hardware C5 AC coupling; reduced model).
  asig -= vco2(1, kFreq, 2, 1-kPwmWidth) + a(2*kPwmWidth-1)
endif

if(<dco_sub_enabled> == 1) then
  asig += vco2(kSubLevel, kFreq * 0.5, 10)
endif

if(<dco_noise_enabled> == 1) then
  asig += random:a(-1, 1) * kNoiseLevel
endif

;; Common HPF and patch LEVEL are in the always-on output stage.

;; VCF
;; cutoff (Hz) = 7.8 * 2^(freq + keytrack + env + lfo) in octaves
acut init 0
kcut_freq = (<vcf_freq> / 10) * 16.6667 ;; svc. manual 8-2: FREQ=3 -> 248Hz
kcut_kybd = (<vcf_kybd> / 10) * (octcps(ifreq) - 8) ;; 8-3/8-4: ref = middle C
kcut = kcut_freq + kcut_kybd + (klfo * kLfoModOct)



acut_env = aEnv * kEnvModOct

if(<vcf_invert> == 1) then
  acut = -acut_env
else
  acut = acut_env
endif

acutoff = 7.8 * exp(0.6931472 * limit(acut + kcut, -10, 14)) ;; 7.8Hz * 2^oct; juno60vcf guards cutoff at its internal oversampled rate
asig = juno60vcf(asig, acutoff, kResonance, 1)
;; VCA
;; 0 = env, 1 = gate

asig *= iamp
if(i(<vca_mode>) == 0) then
  ; Reduced C9 control network: direct feedthrough plus a 10.78ms pole.
  ; TR6 loading/offset and the IR3R01 curve remain provisional.
  aEnvPole = tone(aEnv, sr/(6.283185307179586)*cosinv(2-cosh(1/(sr*.01078))))
  aVca = (12/49)*aEnv + (37/49)*aEnvPole
  xtratim(iEnvR + .15)
else
  ; C9=.22uF: charge via 5.6k || 22k, discharge via 22k.
  ; Exponential segments truncate at 14 tau (residual below 1ppm).
  iGateOn = .22e-6 / (1/5600 + 1/22000)
  iGateOff = .22e-6 * 22000
  aVca = transegr:a(0, 14*iGateOn, -14, 1, 14*iGateOff, -14, 0)
endif
; Default native 4x medium sinc: measured delay is 94 caller samples.
; Extend the voice to flush the delayed VCA release and RC tail.
xtratim((i(<vca_mode>) == 0 ? iEnvR + .15 : 14*iGateOff) + 94/sr)
asig *= delay(aVca, 94/sr)


blueMixerOut asig, asig

skipInit:
